summary: Frontend-only verification of 3 recent UI changes on the freshly-served Expo Web build at https://39bi06s-emergent_chandan-3001.exp.direct/services (mobile viewport 390x844). Tunnel is up (HTTP 200, title 'AzoApp Customer'). The services page renders and the latest bundle IS being served (verified by presence of new markup / testids and the new chip border-radius). However, the production backend api.webhubmaster.shop rejects the Expo tunnel origin with 'Disallowed CORS origin' on OPTIONS preflight, so /api/site/config, /api/catalog/categories, /api/catalog/services and /api/auth/config all fail. Result: page shows 'No services found', so no service cards / add buttons / view-booking-bar could be triggered, blocking tests 2, 3 and 4. Test 1 (chip shape) passes cleanly.

critical.issue: CORS preflight returns 400 'Disallowed CORS origin' for Origin https://39bi06s-emergent_chandan-3001.exp.direct. Backend CORS allowlist does not include the current Expo tunnel host, which prevents the customer web app from loading catalog/categories/services/config and blocks all data-dependent UI verification.

integration_issues.issue: All API calls blocked by CORS -> page renders shell + 'All' chip + 'No services found'. Cannot exercise Add flow, view-booking-bar, or Service Detail page.

verified_features.feature: Web app loads (no white screen / fatal error)
verified_features.evidence: Title 'AzoApp Customer'; services header 'All Services' + 'Browse and book verified home-service experts near you.' render; no pageerror; only CORS console errors.

verified_features.feature: Category chips are square with small rounded corners (~12px, not pill)
verified_features.evidence: [data-testid="services-cat-all"] computed borderRadius = '12px', height = 36px, width = 49px. Clearly not a fully-rounded pill (would be ~18px for a 36px-tall pill).

verified_features.feature: Tapping Add makes view-booking-bar fixed at bottom
verified_features.evidence: No [data-testid^="add-"] elements present because /api/catalog/services was blocked by CORS. Cannot trigger the bar.
No [data-testid^="svc-"] service cards rendered (CORS-blocked services list), so unable to navigate into a detail page.

action_items: Add https://39bi06s-emergent_chandan-3001.exp.direct (and ideally *.exp.direct or the current tunnel host) to the CORS allowlist on api.webhubmaster.shop so the freshly-served Expo web build can actually load catalog data. Currently OPTIONS returns 400 'Disallowed CORS origin'.
After CORS is fixed, re-run tests 2/3/4 (Add -> fixed bottom bar; Service Detail should NOT contain add-to-booking-mobile, must contain go-checkout-mobile + item-total).
critical_code_review_comments: The customer web build depends on a hard-coded production backend that maintains its own CORS origin allowlist; every time the Expo tunnel URL rotates, the app becomes non-functional on web until the backend allowlist is updated. Consider (a) regex/allow *.exp.direct for dev, or (b) reading the tunnel origin from an env var and auto-registering, or (c) routing dev web through a same-origin proxy.

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend-only run; backend CORS confirmed broken for this origin)
success_rate.frontend: 1/4 verifiable checks passed, 3/4 blocked by backend CORS (not an app-code bug)

The blocker is backend CORS: api.webhubmaster.shop returns HTTP 400 'Disallowed CORS origin' on OPTIONS from this tunnel Origin. Once the backend team whitelists the tunnel host, re-run: (1) reload /services, (2) confirm multiple services-cat-<id> chips also have borderRadius 12px, (3) click first [data-testid^="add-"] and assert [data-testid="view-booking-bar"] has computed position fixed/absolute with bottom near window.innerHeight and rectBottom == innerHeight, (4) click first [data-testid^="svc-"], on detail page assert !document.querySelector('[data-testid="add-to-booking-mobile"]') AND document.querySelector('[data-testid="go-checkout-mobile"]') AND document.querySelector('[data-testid="item-total"]').
rca of the issue: Root cause of blocked verification: backend CORS allowlist on api.webhubmaster.shop does not include the currently-active Expo tunnel origin (https://39bi06s-emergent_chandan-3001.exp.direct). Reproduction: `curl -i -X OPTIONS 'https://api.webhubmaster.shop/api/catalog/services' -H 'Origin: https://39bi06s-emergent_chandan-3001.exp.direct' -H 'Access-Control-Request-Method: GET' -H 'Access-Control-Request-Headers: content-type'` -> HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request, body 'Disallowed CORS origin'. Mitigation: append the tunnel host (or a *.exp.direct regex) to the backend CORS allowed_origins config and reload the service.
